In adults, systolic blood pressure rises from early adulthood onward, up to at least age 70. - Name, surname and date of birth of the certificate holder
- Unique identifier of the certificate
- Validity of the certificate

- The person in charge proceeds to visually check the correspondence of the personal data of the holder shown by the VerificationC19 app and certificate holder ID card.
